verdict.rationale: Runloop documents an MCP Hub that gives agents running in its Devboxes access to MCP tool servers without exposing credentials. That is a first-party mechanism for plugging MCP servers in so agents can use their tools. The only evidence is a single one-line doc summary, so setup, supported server types and tool-invocation depth are unproven. The official MCP server probe covers the server role, not this client-side story, so it is not credited. missing for 10: details on registering or configuring arbitrary MCP servers, supported transports and auth, tool-discovery and invocation behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
